description: This file contains custom exception classes and related error handling logic for a FastAPI project, including HTTP and WebSocket exceptions, validation errors, and internal error classes.

classes.name: HTTPException
classes.description: Custom HTTP exception class extending Starlette's HTTPException, allowing raising HTTP errors within FastAPI applications.

classes.name: WebSocketException
classes.description: Custom WebSocket exception class extending Starlette's WebSocketException for WebSocket error handling.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: Base class for validation errors, encapsulating error details and associated endpoint context.

classes.name: RequestValidationError
classes.description: Validation error class for request data validation issues.

classes.name: WebSocketRequestValidationError
classes.description: Validation error class for WebSocket request validation issues.

classes.name: ResponseValidationError
classes.description: Validation error class for response validation issues.

classes.name: PydanticV1NotSupportedError
classes.description: Error indicating usage of unsupported pydantic v1 models.

classes.name: FastAPIError
classes.description: General exception class for FastAPI-specific errors.

classes.name: DependencyScopeError
classes.description: Error class indicating a dependency declared with an invalid scope.

classes.name: FastAPIDeprecationWarning
classes.description: Custom warning class for deprecation notices in FastAPI.
